charts.title: TOI-715 b: orbits around TOI-715
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-715's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-715 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Dransfield et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.527...35D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DRANSFIELD_ET_AL_2024): P 19.288004 d

charts.title: TOI-715 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-715 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (96, 97, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 271971130, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 12 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min early; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
